svg.title: Who holds the plan
svg.desc: A path for choosing how to split a job. If one conversation can do it without filling up, keep it in the main conversation. Otherwise, if the workers must talk to each other, a lead holds the plan in an agent team, which is experimental. If they need not talk and the job needs cross-checked findings or a rerun, a script holds the plan in a dynamic workflow. If it is one large change that splits into independent units, /batch runs one subagent per unit in its own worktree. Otherwise Claude holds the plan and subagents return summaries.
